behaviors.description: Force removal of old files during an update while the old app remains running.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A/B app commits and a live holding A sandbox.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary update retains the old sandbox's payload; force-remove deletes that entry. Both install exact B and preserve the runtime, with a newly launched app reporting B.

mappings.rationale: Public enter probes observe the old sandbox mount directly while independent state queries verify the new deployment.

surface_assertions.rationale: Forced update deletes old payload files retained by an ordinary update of a running app.
